item.title: Cisco Unified Communications Manager Cross-Site Scripting Vulnerability
item.description: A vulnerability in the web-based management interface of Cisco Unified Communications Manager (Unified CM) and Cisco Unified Communications Manager Session Management Edition (Unified CM SME) could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to conduct a cross-site scripting (XSS) attack against a user of the interface. This vulnerability exists because the web-based management interface does not properly validate user-supplied input. item.title: Cisco UCS Central Software Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
item.description: A vulnerability in the web-based management interface of Cisco UCS Central Software could allow an authenticated, remote attacker to achieve remote code execution or conduct information disclosure attacks on an affected device. This vulnerability is due to insufficient validation of user-supplied input in an HTTP request. An attacker could exploit this vulnerability by sending a crafted HTTP request to an affected endpoint on an affected device. A successful exploit could allow the attacker to execute arbitrary commands, write arbitrary files to the filesystem, and obtain sensitive information

item.title: Cisco Identity Services Engine Authorization Bypass Vulnerability
item.description: A vulnerability in the authorization mechanism of Cisco Identity Services Engine (ISE) and Cisco ISE Passive Identity Connector (ISE-PIC) could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to obtain an endpoint identity certificate. This vulnerability is due to improper authorization checks. An attacker could exploit this vulnerability by sending a crafted request to an affected device. A successful exploit could allow the attacker to bypass authorization to obtain an endpoint certificate. Cisco has released software updates that address this vulnerability. item.title: Vulnerabilities in Node.js and Brotli Affecting Cisco Products: October 2026
item.description: On October 21, 2026, Node.js announced the availability of fixes for multiple vulnerabilities across the following supported release lines: 22.x, 24.x, and 26.x. These vulnerabilities impact critical operations such as the Brotli decoder, DNS resolution, and TLS certificate validation. The vulnerabilities pose risks for remote code execution and traffic interception. For more information, see Node.js Security Release . item.title: 「Ruby on Rails」にアップデート - 脆弱性21件を修正
item.description: ウェブアプリケーションフレームワーク「Ruby on Rails」に複数の脆弱性が明らかとなった。深刻な脆弱性も含まれており、セキュリティアップデートが提供されている。

item.title: 涙に叱責に持論……GMO熊谷代表の謝罪会見、どこがまずかった？ 危機管理広報のプロが分析
item.description: GMOインターネットグループの熊谷正寿代表は11月2日、グループ企業で発生した不正アクセス問題を巡り、約3時間半にわたる記者会見を開いた。持論の展開や涙、社員への叱責など、本来の説明とは別の「撮れ高」を生んだ会見から企業は何を学ぶべきか、危機管理広報の視点から検証する。
